dduchi.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production landscape asset for Bogle children's picture-book iPad app. Create ONE ultra-wide panoramic illustration, 2048x576 pixels, about 3.5:1. Scene: a cosy forest of rounded oak trees, acorns, ferns, tiny mushrooms and a winding footpath; quiet brave hedgehog's woodland. Style: clean flat 2D vector-like storybook illustration, simple playful rounded shapes, no outlines, minimal detail, gentle friendly calm, saturated pastel colours matching cream and lavender app with aqua and soft blue accents #8BA2FF. Daytime soft light. Composition designed for an arched window crop: top corners and sky plain, main shapes in lower two thirds and between 20% and 80% of width. Leave central vertical strip and band 38% above bottom free of important objects because window bars cross there. Fill edge to edge opaque scenery, ground along bottom edge. No actual window, frame, bars, curtains, border, vignette, text, letters, numbers, logos, people, faces, characters, mascots, foreground animals, photograph, 3D, grain, clutter or harsh shadows. It must be an outdoor view only.
